name: Video Frame Rate
algorithm: Video Frame Rate — Statistical Pattern Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes video frame rate characteristics for forensic detection:

1. **EffectiveFrameRate估计**: The actual effective frame rate is measured from inter-frame differences (beyond the declared container frame rate). This detects: (a) duplicated frames (effective rate lower than declared), (b) frame interpolation (artificially increased rate), (c) variable frame rate.

2. **FrameRateConversion检测**: If the deepfake was generated at a different frame rate and converted, frame rate conversion artifacts are detectable: blend frames (intermediate alpha-blended frames), motion trajectory irregularities, and periodic motion discontinuities at the source-target rate ratio.

3. **人脸-BackgroundFrameRate一致性**: In composited deepfakes, the face and background may originate from different frame rate sources. The method independently estimates effective frame rates for face and background regions using their respective motion characteristics. Frame rate mismatches indicate compositing.

4. **时间Aliasing分析**: Frame rate determines the temporal sampling frequency (Nyquist limit). Motion exceeding the Nyquist limit produces temporal aliasing (wagon wheel effect). The method checks whether aliasing behavior is consistent across the frame. Different effective frame rates in face vs. background produce different aliasing characteristics.

5. **FrameTimingRegularity**: The inter-frame timing should be regular for constant-frame-rate video. The method analyzes timing regularity — irregular intervals may indicate: variable frame rate from the generator, dropped frames during processing, or asynchronous capture-generation timing.
parameters:
分析类型: 统计
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through 视频 frame rate analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow based CNN. ICCV Workshop.
Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
